contentPattern.structure: header row of product/tier columns + one row per feature with tick/cross/'Optional'/value cells

suitableFor: product/tier feature-comparison grids (multiple products x many feature rows)
cover-comparison tables with tick / cross / 'Optional' / price value cells
at-a-glance side-by-side capability matrices with badge/logo column headers
notSuitableFor: narrative or single-datapoint content (use default content)

usage.notes: Car-insurance cover-comparison tables (two instances, one per tabs-cover panel). First column = cover feature label; header columns = Admiral Platinum / Gold / Admiral / Essential (badge images); cells contain tick (badge-tick.svg), cross (badge-cross.svg), 'Optional' text, or £ value. Nested inside the Section 7 tabs-cover block.
